curation.notes: Time-shared optical tweezer microrheology (TimSOM) on an Impetux SENSOCELL unit: one 1064 nm beam is AOD-split into two time-shared traps on a single probe (1 µm microsphere or endogenous lipid droplet) for simultaneous force/displacement active microrheology; validated in glycerol, PAA gels and PDMS, then applied to MEC-2 and CPEB4 condensates, zebrafish progenitor-cell cytoplasm/nucleus (incl. force-clamp bead insertion) and C. elegans intestinal cells of lamin/emerin/LEM-2 mutants during ageing. Probes are single beads in a medium, not a dumbbell tether.

evidence.snippet: The AODs are addressed at a frequency of 25 kHz, for which each trap is addressed at 12.5 kHz in the dual-trap time-sharing configuration
